topic: Factors Affecting the Strength of an Electromagnet
key_concepts: Magnets attract metallic objects such as iron, steel, nickel, and cobalt.
Magnetism is the property of magnets to attract metallic objects.
Magnets have north and south poles; opposite poles attract while like poles repel.
An electromagnet is a temporary magnet produced by electric current flowing through a coil
The main parts of an electromagnet are the iron core, insulated wire, and power source.
The iron core concentrates magnetic flux, the wire carries current, and the power source s
More coils of wire around the core make the electromagnet stronger.
Increasing the electric current or number of dry cells makes the electromagnet stronger.
Using a soft iron core makes the electromagnet stronger.
The magnetism of an electromagnet can be turned on and off by controlling electric current
